name: Chest Pain
overview: Chest Pain is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include discomfort or pain in the chest as a medical symptom. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: In routine practice, chest pain is pain or discomfort in the chest, typically the front of the chest.
Health professionals note that it may be described as sharp, dull, pressure, heaviness or squeezing.
From a clinical perspective, associated symptoms may include pain in the shoulder, arm, upper abdomen, or jaw, along with nausea, sweating, or shortness of breath.
Health professionals note that it can be divided into heart-related and non-heart-related pain.
Health professionals note that pain due to insufficient blood flow to the heart is also called angina pectoris.
